high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "bloomberggreen," which is located in California. The post features a photograph of a large hydroelectric dam situated in a dry, arid landscape. The surrounding area appears to be mostly barren with patches of dry grass and sparse vegetation. In the background, there are some trees and hills, indicating a semi-rural or mountainous region. The text overlay on the image reads: "California's dry season is turning into a permanent state of being" by Bloomberg Green.
